svg.text: Stripe order in the doped Hubbard cylinder — 16×4, U=8t, δ=1/8 hole doping
width-4 cylinder (y-periodic), site-split d=4 fast block path, packed (N, 2Sz) sectors; χ=1024, 20 sweeps (DMRG3S mixer), staggered pinning h=0.5 at x=0; E₀=-48.2635t (3085s)
staggered spin (−1)x+y⟨Sz⟩ (colour) and per-site hole density (circle area)
uniform colour = antiferromagnetic domain; red↔blue flip = the π phase shift at each charge stripe
column x (cylinder axis; pinned edge at x=0)
